draftPR.body:
Current and next soundtrack recordings were fully scanned synchronously before reaching the playback inspector. Route that scan through the existing reusable inspector, then reuse its validated facts only for the same acquired Blob. Digest and descriptor validation, bounded fallback, and source/transport cancellation remain enforced.

Adds twelve controls for worker execution, current/next playback, validation identity, cancellation, timeout and paused fallback. Source review is complete; hosted execution is pending. Keep this PR draft for source qualification. No performance or device pass is claimed.
